title: Binance bounded-sample execution-cost and adverse-selection feasibility probe (not a directional-alpha strategy)
mechanism: Feasibility/execution research, excluded from historical-confirmation candidates by protocol-amendment.json. Estimates effective spread (Roll trade-only proxy; quoted spread from official bookTicker), 5s-horizon adverse selection (signed-flow price-impact slope with sign from the official is_buyer_maker flag), snapshot liquidity depth (+/-1% band notional), and a naive maker-vs-taker execution benchmark at a fixed 10k decision notional. No directional signal is proposed or evaluated; the required returns.csv records deterministic execution-cost accounting against a fee-free mid reference, not alpha.

data_used.canonical_data: quant-trading/data/raw/binance 1h bars and the data manifest were read for schema context only; no metric in this dossier derives from them

development_window: 2024 single days as labeled (2024-03-29 quotes; 2024-06-17 trades/depth). Wave-one treats all sampled observations as development data; no parameter selection consumed any later calendar.
validation_window: No independent validation window exists for a single-day microstructure bound; the validation-vs-development split is not applicable to a feasibility probe and is honestly reported as such.

parameters.variant_budget_used: 3 estimation methods (Roll spread, signed-flow impact, realized spread) + 1 benchmark; no free hyperparameters, no selection

signal_timing: Not directional. Execution measurements use transaction-time stamps only: impact pairs trade t to last trade strictly within [t, t+5s]; maker benchmark is conditional on a decision-time touch. No bar-close timing, no lead of price.

cost_model.taker: 12 bps one-way (contract crypto_spot_one_way_bps) baseline; stress = 2x fee + 2 bps latency caveat = 26 bps
cost_model.maker: 0 bps banner-fee naive fill-at-touch + measured 5s pick-off proxy; stress adds labeled +5 bps queue-miss caveat
cost_model.application: per round trip in returns.csv; benchmark column is the fee-free mid-to-mid reference the contract requires
cost_model.fee_tier_disclaimer: contract-conservative assumption, not the user's actual fee tier

benchmark: Fee-free zero-cost execution of the same notional (benchmark_return=0 in returns.csv), per the contract's mandatory naive baseline for a cost-accounting probe. No directional benchmark (buy-and-hold) applies because no directional position is taken.

BTC_spot_2024-06-17.roll_effective_spread: not identifiable (nonnegative first autocovariance on sampled days)

naive_maker_vs_taker_at_10k.interpretation: naive maker EV is 75-230x cheaper than taker ONLY under an unachievable zero-queue-risk assumption; feasible maker advantage sits between the label-free bounds and cannot be pinned down without queue data

first_falsification_gate.definition: This is execution research; the gate is an empirical cost/implementation-shortfall bound, not accuracy/F1. Gate: produce an implementation-shortfall estimate for one concrete execution rule (maker-at-touch with a stated refill/queue policy) from at least two non-contiguous days where trades and quotes pair on the same calendar date, with mean per-decision IS strictly below the 12 bps taker baseline net of a >= 5 bps queue penalty, and a per-day cluster bootstrap CI excluding zero advantage.
first_falsification_gate.result: NOT EVALUABLE on the official 2024 archive: no calendar date admits same-day trade+quote pairing (spot bookTicker never published for 2024; UM-perp bookTicker ends 2024-03-30 while the UM aggTrades daily series ends 2021-05-13). The gate cannot pass or fail on data that does not exist.

leakage_checks.holdout_calendar: PASS - every retained observation timestamp is <= 2024-06-18; run.py fails closed if --end > 2024-12-31 without QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1 and also refuses any unlocked run because the sample contains no post-2024 data; guard verified by execution (FAIL CLOSED observed, exit path exercised)
leakage_checks.signal_timing: PASS - measurements are contemporaneous/forward-only within 5s windows; no bar-close substitution; no future quote used to label a past trade
leakage_checks.universe: PASS - BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT only; no cross-sectional selection
leakage_checks.selection_bias: transparent - sample days were chosen for calendar spread across market regimes (March pre-halving, June summer) before any estimator ran; single-day bounds are labeled as such and no cross-day robustness is claimed
leakage_checks.trial_budget: PASS - 3 estimation methods, 0 tunable variants, well under the 12-variant cap; every method is reported including the one that failed to identify

risks: Single-day samples: all bounds are point-in-time (liquidity regimes differ massive across 2024); generalization risk is high by construction
Maker benchmark assumes fill-at-touch with zero queue risk - explicitly unachievable; real maker economics are bounded, not measured
Trade signs from is_buyer_maker flag are venue-local aggressor labels; cross-venue flow and hidden orders are invisible
Roll estimator failed to identify on both sampled days (sub-tick effective spread), so spot effective spread remains an upper bound, not an estimate
Archive gaps: no 2024 spot quotes anywhere; UM quotes end 2024-03-30; UM daily aggTrades end 2021-05-13; any 2024 full-year quote research is impossible on official data
Binance-dumped top-of-book may not reflect full book priority/latency structure of a live matching engine

next_experiment.verdict: VIABLE WITH CONSTRAINTS - bounded execution-cost research is possible on official archives; queue/latency mechanic research is not
minimum_future_capture: 3-5 non-contiguous UM-perp days in 2024 (e.g., 2024-01-15, 2024-03-29 sampled, plus 2024-07-x, 2024-10-x) using monthly trades (~30-60 MB/day compressed) ALIGNED with the 2024-03-30-cutoff bookTicker is impossible, so instead: collect UM-perp monthly bookTicker for months available (2023-05..2024-03, ~1 GB/month compressed BTC) and pair with monthly aggTrades of the same months (~2-6.7 GB/month compressed BTC)

Bounded proposal: 2 months x (bookTicker + aggTrades) for BTC = ~14-20 GB; 1 month for ETH = ~4-8 GB; fits a research-grade budget only if the 250 MB cap is raised or waived for a declared success-criteria sub-window (e.g., single 48h high/low volatility brackets)
Alternative zero-download path: user's own execution logs (orders + fills + timestamps) from any compliant source; a single week of live-shaped logs beats any archive subset for IS calibration
next_experiment.pnl_implementation_shortfall_gate: Advance to validation-pass ONLY IF: (1) frozen maker rule achieves mean per-decision implementation shortfall (fill vs decision-time mid, fees included) at least 5 bps better than immediate-cross taker, net of a >= 5 bps queue-miss penalty; (2) >= 1000 decisions across >= 5 non-contiguous days; (3) per-day-clustered bootstrap 95% CI of the advantage excludes zero; (4) 2x-cost stress preserves nonnegative cumulative advantage. Accuracy/F1 of any fill-classifier is explicitly ineligible to pass this gate.
next_experiment.blocked_conditions_to_declare: If the quote-era trade-paired months (2023-05..2024-03) are judged not representative of 2024 fee/liquidity regimes, or the bytes cap stays at 250 MB, then the correct terminal status for queue-mechanics research is blocked with the exact gaps recorded in trials.json; the 10k-notional cost conclusion (taker 12-26 bps vs maker 0.05-5.2 bps bound) already stands regardless.
